purpose: Determine which live input capabilities can be offered without turning detector uncertainty into learner errors.
status: engineering fixtures only; physical interface and recorded-guitar qualification pending
splitUnit: recording group; keep all excerpts and transformations together; hold out performers and instruments where possible
qualificationEvidence: Real independently annotated guitar, physical onset measurement and display capture. Generated tones and virtual browser input cannot qualify hardware or musical generalization.
gradingErrors: Report false corrections and false successes separately from classification precision. An interrupted or unknown response is never incorrect.
latency: Measure physical monitoring, onset-to-display, and accompaniment alignment separately. Offline replay delay is only the number of supplied audio samples before detection.
intervals: Wilson 95% intervals for fixture proportions; recording-group bootstrap for a recorded cohort, with recording-macro metrics and register/family/input slices.
paidCalls: No fresh budget. Require reconciled historical spending and shared atomic reservations across every active worktree before any actor, critic, qualification or judge call.
publication: Retain original failures; Weave replay never repeats actor inference. Reconcile remote row hashes, outputs, scores, Lens conversation/turn IDs and usage. Unexecuted arms remain unavailable.
privacy: Only authored/public eligible evidence may enter research publication. Private audio, device names and continuous observations stay local.
